Card Q&A.a: Yes, since this Digimon is treated as both yellow and blue during your turn, it can digivolve into a Digimon with a requirement of "Blue, Level 5."
Card Q&A.q: Can this Digimon digivolve into a Digimon with a digivolution condition of "Blue, Level 5"?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. [Your Turn] effects don't activate from breeding areas, so the card isn't treated as a yellow card. You can't digivolve it into a Digimon that requires a blue Digimon.
